newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline edges up, fundamentals seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline edges up, fundamentals seen bullish.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices edged higher on Monday in a slow start to the week but traders said the fundamentals were bullish.
A Eurograde barge traded earlier at $238 fob ARA and traders said offers were heard up to $240.

Traders said gasoline was buoyed by crude's rally, further stock building before the U.K. government's budget on November 26, and a cut in gasoline production as refiners maximize distillate output due to favorable margins. Nov swaps rose about $3.50 to $231 and Dec added $2 to $212. -- John Hanley, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185
